note: Per-photo author's notes and the option row rendered beneath each image. Keyed by ORIGINAL photo path; publish.py rewrites the keys to the published barebones paths. Hand-edit freely — tools/build_photo_options.py only fills in what is missing and never overwrites an existing value. `downloads` is an explicit list so the buttons stop being guessed from capture dates; `note` is per photo, so two images of the same object can say different things.

note.en: This image contains the comet 169P/NEAT but I have no clue which streak it is or if it is even visible, it should be just to the opposite side of the bright stars near centerframe.
